<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a resource that's necessary in order to start events at the [[Talking Skull]], never actually possessed by the player as an item, similar to how {{Fuel}} is consumed to perform certain crafting tasks at the [[oven]] or [[furnace]]s. To obtain Tavern reputation ([[file:Tavern reputation.png|16px]]), simply supply the Talking Skull tavern with [[Fermentation#Brewing|Beer]], [[Booze]], [[Fermentation#Brewing|Mead]] and [[Wine]] it will be automatically sold to the villagers. The higher the quality of the drinks, the more [[file:Tavern reputation.png|16px]] will be earned.
